name: testimonials-section-03
title: Editorial testimonial section
description: A split-pane testimonial section with customer portrait, vertical divider, editorial quote typography, and circular previous/next navigation.

useCases: Founders and product leadership case studies

a11y.reducedMotion: Each change is a plain fade: the quote lines and author details fade in line by line without sliding or blurring, the portrait cross-fades, and the arrow buttons don't shrink when pressed.

keyboard.action: Shows the previous or next testimonial
Shows the previous or next testimonial while focus is inside the section, never from a text field

notes: A visually hidden h2 names the section, “Customer Testimonials” by default (set with title).
The quote is a blockquote split into one span per displayed line; the hidden copy used to measure lines is aria-hidden.
The portrait’s alt text is the customer’s name, like “Sam Davies”, and the arrow buttons are named “Previous testimonial” and “Next testimonial”.
A polite `role="status"` region reads each change you make, like “Testimonial 2 of 5. Elena Rostova, Head of Infrastructure, Stratum Dynamics:” and the quote; autoplay changes stay silent.
gaps: With autoPlayInterval set, it advances on a timer with no pause control (WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide); autoplay is off by default.
